name: BTR-82A / BTR-80 family
armament: 14.5 mm KPVT + 7.62 mm PKT in the older BTR-80 turret
protection: Light steel armour with spall liner. Game: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Boat-shaped 8x8 hull, 4 evenly spaced axles; amphibious water-jet at the rear
Small conical one-man turret centred over the second axle (BTR-80: short KPVT; BTR-82A: long thin 30 mm barrel with smoke dischargers)
Side doors split horizontally between 2nd and 3rd axles; angular vision blocks
2026 Russian: anti-drone cage over the roof, slat/mesh panels on the flanks, logs and tyres piled on the deck

colour_schemes.name: Russian protective green with white Z/V/triangle ID marks

variants: BTR-82A (RUS, BLR, KAZ, AZE, Africa Corps)
